identity_rule: There is one Prompt Kit website release. Local, portable, preview, installed, and public delivery surfaces must resolve to or derive from the exact canonical artifact; none may become an independent product version authority.

release_identity.version_label_policy: A visible vXX label is descriptive UI metadata only and never sufficient proof of release identity or freshness.

phone_launcher.required_behavior: route to the canonical public Prompt Kit; the launcher is not a second Prompt Kit

windows_portable.required_behavior: derive from the exact canonical artifact and record its SHA-256 before adding only the registered portability runtime

local_preview.required_behavior: serve the canonical artifact directly or a declared temporary derivative that records the canonical source hash; never use an unregistered local index.html as release authority

drift_failures: artifact registry points prompt-kit-website at a path other than web/prompt-kit/index.html
Pages publishes a Prompt Kit that is not compared byte-for-byte with web/prompt-kit/index.html
portable/local generation uses a source other than web/prompt-kit/index.html
portable artifact receipt omits the canonical source SHA-256
freshness guidance treats a visible version label or old local copy as proof of currentness
documentation describes the local/portable site as a separate Prompt Kit version rather than a delivery derivative
an operator is told to guess which index.html is current instead of resolving prompt-kit-website through the artifact registry

failure_route.stale_or_different_local_surface: Mark the local surface stale-or-unverified, resolve prompt-kit-website from harness/artifacts.v1.json, prove current main, rebuild or reacquire through the registered launcher, then compare the canonical source hash before troubleshooting product behavior.
failure_route.public_surface_drift: Stop release claims, run builder parity and Pages contract validation, and repair the product/release lane; do not bless a second canonical artifact from the harness lane.

proof_ceiling: Static contract proof that repository delivery surfaces name one canonical Prompt Kit artifact and that registered local/public builders preserve source identity. It does not prove a specific user's local checkout, browser cache, service worker, deployed Pages bytes, or installed app currently matches main without runtime hash evidence.
